phone.native.welcome.title: Nocturne lives on your computer
phone.native.welcome.lead: This app lets you keep things, ask and read your page while you’re out. It works with Nocturne on your computer.
phone.native.welcome.step1: On your computer, open Nocturne and choose {settings}, then {awayFromHome}, then {addAPhone}.
phone.native.welcome.step2: Scan the code it shows, or type the address and the code.
phone.native.welcome.foot: No account and no sign-in. This phone keeps no copy of your memory.
phone.native.welcome.link: No Nocturne on your computer yet?
phone.native.cameraOff.title: The camera is off for Nocturne.
phone.native.cameraOff.body: Allow it in your phone’s settings, or type the code instead.
phone.native.address.title: Your computer’s address
phone.native.address.lead: On your computer, under the code, find the four words or the name. Type it here.
phone.native.address.hint: Simple shows four words. Most private shows a name. Capitals don’t matter.
phone.native.address.incomplete: Type all four words, or the full name.
phone.native.address.noAnswer.simple: That address didn’t answer. Check the words, and that your computer is awake.
phone.native.address.noAnswer.private: That address didn’t answer. Check the name, and that Tailscale is on for this phone.
phone.native.code.title: Type the code
phone.native.code.lead: Now the 24 letters and numbers under the address on your computer.
